title: Design Services for Juvenile Justice Control System Modernization
short_description: Modernization of detention control systems at the Galveston County Juvenile Justice Center.
project_scope: Design, furnishing, and installation of a fully integrated detention control system modernization at the Galveston County Juvenile Justice Center. The project replaces an aging GE Fanuc PLC and hard-panel console with a non-proprietary touchscreen-and-mouse control interface integrating door, intercom, and camera systems. The notice indicates rehabilitation and refurbishment within an existing justice facility.
services: Design services for detention control system modernization; architecture services; interior design/space planning; landscape architecture; programming; rehabilitation and refurbishment; civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a detention control system modernization, not a structural or architecturally demanding project.
- Focus is on integrated control, door, intercom, and camera systems rather than load-bearing structures.
- Falls closer to building systems and refurbishment than sbp's core interests in bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, or complex buildings.
- Justice facility modernization offers little evident structural innovation or lightweight/sustainable engineering potential.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. The notice only provides a total construction cost of 55.0M USD and lists broad design disciplines, but no fee basis, percentage, or budget allocation for structural/planning services.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms are requested; no specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
